Ignition Switch

N08879

IGNITION SWITCH INSPECTION

INSPECT SWITCH CONTINUITY

Switch position | Tester connection to terminal number | Specified condition
Lock | — | No continuity
ACC | 5 – 7 | Continuity
ON | 4 – 5 – 7
2 – 3 | Continuity
START | 4 – 7 – 8
1 – 2 – 3 | Continuity

If continuity is not as specified, replace the switch
